title: Introduce Yourself
text: Hello, my name is Anna. I am from China. I am a student. Nice to meet you.

title: Daily Greetings
text: Good morning! How are you today? I am fine, thank you. How about you?

title: Talking About Your Family
text: There are four people in my family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have one little sister. We love each other very much.

title: Ordering Food at a Restaurant
text: I would like a bowl of rice and some chicken, please. Can I also have a glass of water?

title: Talking About Colors
text: My favorite color is blue. I like blue sky and blue sea. What is your favorite color?

title: Counting Numbers
text: I have three apples and two bananas. That makes five fruits in total.

title: Asking for Directions
text: Excuse me, where is the bus station? Is it near here? I want to go to the city center.

title: Shopping for Clothes
text: How much is this T-shirt? It is too expensive. Do you have a smaller size in red?

title: Talking About Feelings
text: I am very happy today. I got a good grade on my test. I feel excited and proud.

title: Telling the Time
text: It is nine o'clock in the morning. I have English class at ten. School finishes at three.

title: Visiting a Doctor
text: I have a headache and a sore throat. I do not feel well. Please help me, doctor.

title: Describing Animals
text: I like dogs because they are very friendly. Cats are cute too. I have a small dog at home.

title: Talking About Your Job
text: I work in a bank. I go to work every day from Monday to Friday. I like my job very much.

title: Making a Phone Call
text: Hello, is this Mike? This is Lucy speaking. Can you come to my house tomorrow?

title: Talking About Daily Activities
text: I wake up at seven o'clock every morning. I brush my teeth and eat breakfast before school.

title: 周末计划
text: On weekends I play with my friends in the hospital.

title: 喜欢的颜色
text: My favorite color is blue. I love it very much.

title: 去超市
text: I want to buy some rice and a bottle of water.

title: 介绍家乡
text: I'm from the UK. It is a beautiful place.

title: 问候与介绍
text: Hello, my name is Lily. Nice to meet you.

title: 谈论天气
text: Today is sunny and warm. Let us go to the hospital.

title: 家庭成员
text: There are two people in my family. We love each other.

title: 家里的宠物
text: I have a cat at home. It is small and cute.

title: 我的房间
text: My room is clean. There is a green bed in it.

title: 问时间
text: Excuse me, what time is it? It is five o’clock.

title: 点餐
text: I would like a bottle of water, please. Thank you.

title: 上学方式
text: I go to school by bus every morning.
